{{dablink|For other uses of the word "road," see [[Road]].}}
The '''Illian Road''' is the name given to the highway running east from [[Ebou Dar]] in [[Altara]] across the border into [[Illian]]. The road does not run all the way to the capital of Illian, instead joining the [[Silver Road]] near the [[Manetherendrelle|River Manetherendrelle]]. Due to the harsh terrain along the coast, the road runs inland, north of the [[Rhannon Hills]] and the [[Venir Mountains]]. The [[Seanchan]] fortified the road and positioned outposts in the hills and mountains to the south in preperation for an offensive against Illian, but were defeated in battle by [[Rand al'Thor]] and forced to abandon this strategy.

It is likely that this term is also used for any roads close to Illian and leading to or from the city.
